info.name: Outmanage API Tests
info.description: Test collection for Outmanage API with valid and invalid request examples to test error handling and logging

request.description: This request retrieves all active users with their roles using pagination. Default values: page=1, limit=10. It should return a 200 status with an array of user objects and pagination metadata.

response.name: Success Response
Invalid Limit Parameter

request.description: This request retrieves all soft-deleted users with their roles. It should return a 200 status with an array of archived user objects.
This request retrieves a specific user by ID with their role details. It should return a 200 status with the user object.

response.name: Valid User Response

item.name: Get User by ID - Invalid ID Format

request.description: This request tests error handling for a non-existent user ID. It should return a 404 status with error details.
This request tests error handling with an invalid email format. It should trigger the Joi validation middleware and return a 400 status with error details.

response.name: Invalid Email Response

request.description: This request tests successful user creation with valid data. It should pass validation and return a 201 status with the created user object.
This request tests error handling with missing required fields. It should trigger the Joi validation middleware and return a 400 status with error details about missing email and password.

response.name: Missing Fields Response

request.description: This request tests password length validation. It should trigger the Joi validation middleware and return a 400 status with error details about the password being too short.

response.name: Short Password Response

This request updates a user with valid data. It should return a 200 status with the updated user object.

response.name: Successful Update Response

request.description: This request tests error handling when no update fields are provided. It should return a 400 status with validation error details.

response.name: No Fields Response

request.description: This request tests validation for an invalid email format. It should return a 400 status with validation error details.

response.name: Invalid Email Response

request.description: This request tests foreign key constraint with a non-existent role ID. It should return a 404 status with error details.
This request soft deletes a user by ID. It should return a 200 status with a success message.
This request tests error handling for an invalid ID format. It should return a 400 status with validation error details.

response.name: Invalid ID Format Response

request.description: This request tests error handling for a non-existent user ID. It should return a 404 status with error details.
This request unarchives (restores) a soft-deleted user. It should return a 200 status with the restored user object.

response.name: Successful Unarchive Response

request.description: This request tests error handling with an invalid ID format. It should return a 400 status with error details about the invalid ID.
This request tests error handling for a non-existent user ID. It should return a 404 status with error details.
This request retrieves logs for a specific user with pagination. It returns a 200 status with an array of log entries and pagination metadata.

response.name: Success Response

request.description: This request retrieves all roles with pagination. It returns a 200 status with an array of role objects and pagination metadata.

response.name: Success Response
Invalid Limit Parameter

request.description: This request retrieves a specific role by ID with its associated users. It should return a 200 status with the role object.

response.name: Valid Role Response

item.name: Get Role by ID - Invalid ID Format

request.description: This request tests error handling with an invalid ID format. It should return a 400 status with error details about the invalid ID.

item.name: Get Role by ID - Role Not Found

request.description: This request tests error handling for a non-existent role ID. It should return a 404 status with error details.
This request creates a new role with valid data. It should return a 201 status with the created role object.
This request tests error handling when trying to create a role with a name that already exists. It should return a 409 Conflict status.
This request tests validation when creating a role without the required name field. It should return a 400 Bad Request status.
This request updates a role with valid data. It should return a 200 status with the updated role object.
This request tests error handling when trying to update a role with a name that already exists. It should return a 409 Conflict status.
This request tests error handling when trying to update a non-existent role. It should return a 404 Not Found status.
This request soft deletes a role that is not associated with any users. It should return a 200 status with the deleted role object.
This request tests error handling when trying to delete a role that is associated with users. It should return a 409 Conflict status.

response.name: Role in Use Response

request.description: This request tests error handling when trying to delete a non-existent role. It should return a 404 Not Found status.
